description: Use this when the user wants to prove they own a domain. Starts proving the organization owns a domain, or checks it again: returns the TXT record to add at the domain's DNS provider (host and value), and whether Apptiller finds it now. Apptiller also looks for it every hour for 72 hours. Calling it again for the same domain keeps the same record. A verified domain proves an app is the organization's when the app's App Store listing points to it.

domain.description: The domain, e.g. damson.life. A pasted URL works too.

name: verify_domain
title: Verify a domain
